persons.name: Bailey
persons.harm: A date withheld her phone, blocked her exit, chased her, and threatened violence. She escaped and later received intimidating jail calls.

contacts.what_institution_did: Took notes, did not pursue the man, and later no report could be found.
contacts.quote: He did take notes while I told him what happened, but he didn't make any effort to go find [perpetrator].
contacts.what_happened_next: She paid for a cab home; months later she independently contacted detectives.

contacts.when: months later, following a public appeal
contacts.what_institution_did: Searched for the earlier report, took her statement and checked video names.
contacts.quote: So the detective asked me some other questions and I was able to tell him what [perpetrator]'s apartment looked like and it's hard, et cetera. So he then told me that I was quote unquote lucky because later in that year, [perpetrator] started drugging, raping, and videoing women.
contacts.what_happened_next: She was added to the witness list; the detective offered further contact if needed.

contacts.when: after calls from Orange County Men’s facility
contacts.what_institution_did: Said she could answer because the line was recorded; no action to stop the calls is described.
contacts.quote: Because my name was on the witness list, his lawyer had access to that information and I started getting calls from the Orange County Men's facility and I never answered. I was terrified to answer, but when I told the detective about it, his advice was that it was okay to answer because the line is recorded, but the last person I wanted to talk to was [perpetrator], or someone that he would have called me to intimidate me. So I never answered those calls.
contacts.notes: The identity and intent of the caller were not confirmed.

contacts.when: while the criminal case was pending
contacts.what_institution_did: Subpoenaed her; repeatedly postponed the case and notified her.
contacts.quote: postponed a lot. I'm not exactly sure on time, but it was it was a lot of I'd get letters like this has been postponed or there's a continuance, et cetera. Since I was on the witness list, they kept me updated.
contacts.what_happened_next: She ultimately was not required to testify.

contacts.what_institution_did: Found the perpetrator guilty and sentenced him to life imprisonment.
contacts.quote: And [perpetrator]. So was found guilty and sentenced to life in prison.
contacts.what_happened_next: She reported sleeping better and no longer having nightmares.

contacts.what_institution_did: Provided therapy she describes as life-changing and healing.
contacts.quote: And the amount of healing that has happened just within those months has been incredible. There are times where I'll say something to my therapist and then she simply says it back to me and it's an epiphany moment.

persons.outcome_quote: And I think for me the biggest factor in my healing though has been that [perpetrator] is behind bars for the rest of his life.
persons.decisive_work_quote: I didn't end up needing to testify in the end because there were so many other witnesses. And for many of those witnesses, there was video evidence. So my testimony wasn't needed.
persons.notes: The initial deputy failed to file a report. Disclosure of the witness list preceded frightening calls, but the caller was not established. Later incarceration supplied the safety she describes.

persons.notes: Reason given: believed lying and excessive texting provided no legal basis for an order. Blocking was her own protective action.
